accepted.question_text: Given an n-dimensional manifold M^n equipped with a metric, develop an effective criterion or procedure for deciding whether that metric can be realized as an isometric embedding of M^n into another manifold of dimension n(n+1)/2.

evidence.quote: One should have an effective way to check whether a metric on M^n can be isometrically embedded into another manifold with dimension n(n+1)/2

accepted.question_text: Determine necessary and sufficient conditions for a discrete subset of the positive real numbers R^+ to occur as the spectrum of the Laplacian on some compact manifold.

evidence.quote: What is the necessary and sufficient condition for a set of discrete numbers in R^+ to be the spectrum of the Laplacian of some compact manifold?

accepted.question_text: Determine whether every calibrated minimal submanifold can be constructed by an explicit method, analogous to the Weierstrass representation, that produces a large class of minimal submanifolds in Euclidean space R^n or on the sphere S^n.
